notes.title: Empire of Lust Demo – Update & Fixes
notes.content:
Hey there! Thanks for playing the Empire of Lust Demo and sending us your feedback! We’ve released a small update that addresses several issues and improves overall stability.🛠️ Here’s what we’ve improved in last update:🔹Reputation display update issue🔹Reputation exploit on mini-game exit🔹Localiztion issues🔹Girl icon state not updating on location🔹Chariot mini-game exploit🔹Minor visual polish🔹Log window UI improvements🔹Gallery now locked on start🔹Sex game balance adjustments

And don't forget this is still the demo — so keep sending in your feedback and thoughts. The more you share, the hotter the full version gets! 😉🔥
